notes.title: TOTAL RELOAD Demo Release
notes.notes:
In TOTAL RELOAD you have to learn to “think with wires,” or in other words, understand that by temporarily supplying power to various objects you can get to previously inaccessible locations. It is difficult to feel the full depth of this game mechanics from a video, so we released a demo that contains 20% of the locations from the full version of the game. In the demo version, you will be able to fully experience what it means to “think with wires” and learn how to interact with some devices: Quantum Transporters, Energy Transmitters, Sensor Grids, Energy Cubes, Energy Converters.

You will be able to start playing the full version of the game from where you finished playing the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082128/fcaabf53db75e7d0d14ac9df41c37e6a23c04181.png[/img]

notes.title: The Central Game Mechanic
notes.notes:
The game world of TOTAL RELOAD consists of many locations connected by special devices for fast movement called Quantum Transporters. Each location has different energy sources that you have to combine into a single network with Quantum Transporters. Some energy sources are located in hard-to-reach places, and to get there, you'll have to use wires to temporarily supply power to various objects: moving platforms, sensor grids, energy filters and closed doors.

In TOTAL RELOAD you have to learn to “think with wires,” or in other words, understand that by temporarily supplying power to various objects you can get to previously inaccessible locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082128/27511f04ee79ea09835a098b1d736ca790667536.png[/img]

notes.title: We wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year
We reveal the name of the main character. This is an AI named HAWKING.
notes.notes:
For a long time during the development process, we called the main character of our game, who is Artificial Intelligence, simply Drone, but any character needs a good name. In the end, we decided to call it HAWKING, because the main theme of [b]TOTAL RELOAD[/b] is the search for absolute knowledge of the Universe and the collection of information about it. In the screenshot you can see a self-portrait of the main character drawn on the wall. As you progress through the game, you will find a large number of similar wall paintings, the meaning of which will be explained to you by HAWKING himself. The AI mind will periodically communicate with you through text comments that will appear on the screen at certain moments. With the help of these comments and drawings you will learn the plot of [b]TOTAL RELOAD[/b].
